items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I was with this minstrel show for a long time... The A.G. Allen Minstrel Show.

ctx.x: I ran away from home when I was fourteen years old, just to try to entertain the people, but I was a little bit too young. I was with this minstrel show for a long time, about...oh, about a couple of years, a year. The A.G. Allen Minstrel Show.
A.G. Allen. Well, Fred, what caused you to run away. I mean, you wanted to get involved in entertainment of some sort?
